## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Keep unrelated changes separate.

## Validation

List checks run, relevant platforms, and anything untested.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and kept generated work outside the checkout.
- [ ] I added focused tests for behavior changes, or explained why they are unnecessary.
- [ ] I updated user guides for changed behavior.
- [ ] I excluded credentials, private content, and generated test evidence.
- [ ] Release, signing, deployment, or live provider changes are within the agreed scope.
